- category: "Non-automatic weighing instrument" — schema examples suggest "Indicator", "Load cell"... For NAUI I'd use "Non-automatic weighing instrument".
- type_designations: ["SHOP"]
- module_designation: null (or "Not applicable"? Not mentioned; omit)

Model family: only one model (SHOP), not a family — so no model_family.

Characteristics:
- accuracy_class: III — actually accuracy class (III). Type-level characteristic.
- maximum_capacity: 6 kg ≤ Max ≤ 30 kg → range {min: 6, max: 30}, unit kg
- verification_scale_interval: e ≥ 2 g → {min: 2, max: null}, unit g
- weighing_ranges: "Multi-interval" → value string "Multi-interval"
- max_number_of_scale_intervals: n ≤ 3000 divisions (per partial weighing range) → {min: null, max: 3000}, unit "divisions" — hmm, divisions isn't a standard unit; unit_symbol could be "divisions" or null. I'll use unit_symbol: "divisions". Note "per partial weighing range" could be noted. Actually maybe include in label or description. Keep simple: value {min:null, max:3000}, unit "divisions".
- max_number_of_partial_weighing_ranges: 2
- tare: formula "T ≤ -(Max1–e1) for multi interval instruments" — string value.
- temperature_range: 0 °C / +40 °C → {min: 0, max: 40}, unit "°C"
- power supply: two entries: 5 VDC via external AC/DC adapter OR 4.5 VDC via 3 AA batteries or rechargeable battery. Split:
  - power_supply_voltage: hmm, two alternative values. Could do config_level with axis "power_source": {condition: "external AC/DC adapter", value: 5 V}, {condition: "3 AA batteries or rechargeable battery", value: 4.5 V}. That seems apt.
  - power_supply_type: "DC"
- application: "Intended to be used for direct sales to the public" — string
- software_identification: "Version number: d1.01.3" → value "d1.01.3"

Recommendation:
- id: R76
- edition: 2006
- accuracy_classes: ["III"]
- scheme: A

Test reports:
- id: NMi-12200133-01, date 2012-07-23, pages 58, role: type_evaluation_report

Revision history: none.

Footnotes: none.

Matrix tables: none.

Output JSON. Decimal conversion: "4,5 VDC" → 4.5.

Let me structure the config_level for power supply voltage:

```json
"config_level": [
  {
    "attribute": "power_supply_voltage",
    "axis": "power_source",
    "values": [
      {"condition": "external AC/DC adapter", "value": 5, "unit_symbol": "V DC"},
      {"condition": "3 AA batteries or rechargeable battery", "value": 4.5, "unit_symbol": "V DC"}
    ]
  }
]
```

Also could include type-level power_supply_type: "DC".

Tare: keep as string formula. Label: tare_limit. Value: "T ≤ -(Max1 - e1)" with description. I'll do value as string "T \u2264 -(Max1 - e1) for multi-interval instruments" — hmm, structured value shape requires {value, unit_symbol, unit_id}. So: {"value": "T ≤ -(Max₁ – e₁)", "unit_symbol": null, "unit_id": null}. Avoid subscripts in LaTeX; plain unicode fine. Keep "T ≤ -(Max1 - e1)".

Accuracy class: "III" — value string "III".
